Syntax: second <weapon>
                 |offhand <weapon>
                 |
                 |Equip a weapon in your off-hand for dual-wielding. Allows you to
                 |wield two weapons simultaneously in combat.
                 |
                 |Requirements:
                 |  - You must already be wielding a primary weapon
                 |  - Your secondary weapon must be considerably lighter than your
                 |    primary weapon (at most 50% of primary weight)
                 |  - You cannot use a shield or held item while dual-wielding
                 |  - Your STR must support the weight of both weapons
                 |
                 |Combat Effects:
                 |  - When your DUAL WIELD skill is high enough, your secondary
                 |    weapon will attack automatically after your primary weapon
                 |  - Your DUAL WIELD skill improves through practice in combat
                 |  - The success chance depends on your dual wield skill and
                 |    whether you're affected by slow effects
                 |
                 |Example:
                 |  second dagger
                 |  offhand shortsword
                 |
                 |See also: wield, hold, dual_wield
